# Bibliography

This appendix collects every work cited in a chapter's *Further reading*
section or in Appendix A's per-section reference lists. A work cited by
several chapters appears once, with all citing chapters listed; where
chapters formatted the same work differently, the more complete form is
kept. Entries are grouped by kind and sorted by first author or issuing
body.
